summary: Tahap 1 revamp Mobile Sales — ALL approved items verified at viewport 390x844 (and 390x600). (1) MobileQuickView kind toggle buy/sample works: sample defaults qty=5 for woven, Per Roll hidden, unit locked, mobile-quickview-add-sample adds sample line. (2) Mobile cart: sample banner (mobile-cart-sample-banner) + sample lines (mobile-cart-sample-<pid>) render; regular cart shows prices; mix notice logic wired via mobile-sales-notice (triggered by mixing attempts — observed via roll-reconcile re-entry path). (3) mobile-checkout-btn opens desktop CheckoutDrawer with all 3 steps functional at 390 width; footer button reachable at 390x600 (submit bbox y=552). All testids present: checkout-customer-select, checkout-address-select, checkout-new-customer-button, payment-term-select, checkout-sales-team, sample-billing-free/paid, request-special-price-<pid>, fulfillment-kirim/ambil, delivery-date-input, checkout-tax-invoice-toggle, checkout-submit. (4) End-to-end created regular SO KSC/SO-00004 (Toko Kain Sejahtera, Rp 30.802.500) → auto-landed on Pesanan tab. Created sample SOS KSC/SOS-00001 (Sampel Gratis) → auto-landed on Pesanan tab and listed in Lainnya. (5) Lainnya → Harga Khusus Saya loads PriceApprovals (price-approvals-view) with all 8 filters (all/pending/approved/rejected/draft/superseded/revoked/cancelled), search, Ajukan modal with full form (customer, product, price, minqty, validuntil, reason, save-draft, save-submit). No horizontal overflow at 390 (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390). (6) Retur status labels Indonesia: 'Pengembalian Dana' (bukan refund_settled) di DEMO_LN093-9195ad — label mapping fixed. (7) Lainnya groups: assist/orders/customers/stock open-by-default; hubs/full closed; last menu item fully above fixed tab bar on scroll (last.bottom=576 < tabbar.top=789). (8) Regression MD mobile (md@kainnusantara.id): mobile-md-app renders; m-md-menu-price-status still loads OLD MobilePriceStatus (4 filters only), tidak terpengaruh. No console 500 encountered.

rca of the issue: Tidak ada bug blocker ditemukan di Tahap 1 scope.
